part.text:
Implemented the fix in `include/fmt/format.h`.

Localized integer formatting now honors all integer presentation types (`x`, `X`, `b`, `B`, `o`, `c`) instead of always formatting as decimal, while preserving locale digit grouping.

Validated:
- `format-test`: all 120 tests pass, including `format_test.format_locale`.
- `xchar-test`: all `locale_test.*` tests pass.
- The reported `{:LX}` case now produces hexadecimal output.
